description:
Compare a single XBRL financial concept across ALL reporting companies for one period (SEC frames API).
The most powerful cross-company tool: rank every filer by revenue, net income, assets, etc. in one call.

PERIOD FORMAT:
- 'CY2023' — full calendar year (use for flow concepts: Revenues, NetIncomeLoss)
- 'CY2023Q1' — single quarter (duration)
- 'CY2023Q4I' — instantaneous / point-in-time (use for balance-sheet concepts: Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity)

UNITS: 'USD' (default), 'shares', 'USD-per-shares' (for EarningsPerShareBasic).

order.description: Sort by value: desc (largest first) or asc

unit.description: Unit of measure: USD, shares, USD-per-shares

name: sec_concept_across_companies
